coupledLoopForward.terminalPortVsInternalLoop: A capacitor physically connected across coil secondary L2 presents a parallel admittance at external winding terminals; for a magnetically induced EMF internal to L2, the closed winding-capacitor circulation equation has equivalent loop series impedance. These are different port abstractions and are NOT contradictory.
coupledLoopForward.model: Two passive linearly coupled windings. Source impressed primary Vs, primary impedance Z1=R1+i*w*L1, secondary internal induced loop Z2=R2+R_L+i*(w*L2-1/(w*C)), mutual M real and passive with M²<=L1*L2. R_L is an equivalent SERIES extraction resistance in this loop, not a verified physical diode/bank.
coupledLoopForward.atResonance: w0=1/sqrt(L2*C), Z2=R2+R_L, I2=-i*w0*M I1/(R2+R_L) and extra positive reflected input resistance Rref=w0²M²/(R2+R_L)
coupledLoopForward.couplingPolarity: M->-M flips secondary current phase by π for same primary current while reflected resistance and power unchanged. A source reference to a magnetic 'pole shift' has a passive sign/phase mechanism but this is not an observed Filsinger implementation.
coupledLoopForward.ambientSteelman: May include a separately sourced environmental power port, but no invented P_env from phase shift. A lossless reactive capacitor has zero averaged real work; all useful work here paid by prescribed drive.

inverseMaxExtraction.additionalAssumptions: Primary reactance compensated at selected electrical omega; prescribed fixed RMS source voltage Vs and positive primary resistance R1; denote K=(omega*M)^2; selected series-equivalent secondary RL extraction.
inverseMaxExtraction.optimum: RL_star=R2+K/R1, NOT simply R2 at fixed source voltage; at fixed I1 instead RL_star=R2.
inverseMaxExtraction.example: Normalized R1=2,R2=3,K=4,Vs=1,RL*=5: Pout=1/20, Pin=2/5, primary copper heat 8/25, secondary loss 3/100, useful fraction 1/8. All units model-defined, NOT Filsinger.

inverseDiscriminators: Whether the cap physically spans NST full A-B, NST A-M, or separately driven L2 is unresolved from the preserved words.
Two physical labels (capacitor, winding) can still be one electrical node pair; opposite diode inputs require actual U and V ends.

At electrical resonance the induced closed-loop secondary may carry quadrature current and load the primary, whereas an externally driven parallel tank may present high input impedance. Both predictions require knowing excitation port.
Changing winding polarity (dot convention) reverses induced secondary-current phase without creating extra real energy.
Strong coupling is bounded by M²<=L1*L2 for linear passive magnetically coupled inductors.
R_L selection needs full source loading: fixed primary current and fixed source voltage yield distinct maximum-output matching conditions.
Any natural Earth donor is separate in the signed energy balance; unknown return/reference cannot be silently promoted into source funding.
